title: Webb County early voting ends Friday — your last early chance before Election Day
excerpt: Early voting in Webb County closes Friday, October 30, at 8 p.m., with more than 33,000 ballots already cast, ahead of Election Day on November 3.
content:
Early voting in Webb County closes Friday, October 30, at 8 p.m. — the last early chance to cast a ballot before Election Day on Tuesday, November 3. More than 33,000 Webb County voters had already voted early as of October 28, according to the county elections office, as reported by KGNS.

During early voting, registered voters may cast a ballot at any early-voting location in the county. The county's published schedule lists final-week hours of 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., Monday through Friday, October 26 to 30, at sites including the Webb County Elections Office at 720 Convent Ave., the Barbara Fasken Recreation Center at 15201 Cerralvo Dr., the Laredo Fire Department Administrative Center at 616 E. Del Mar Blvd., the City Hall Annex Building at 1102 Bob Bullock Loop, the McKendrick, Ochoa, Salinas Library at 1920 Palo Blanco St., Laredo Rehabilitation Hospital at 2005 Bustamante St., and Doctors Hospital at 10700 McPherson Rd. Voters should confirm their site before heading out, since Election Day locations and hours can differ from early-voting ones.

Friday is also the last day for one specific option: Texas voters who moved between counties and have not updated their registration may be able to cast a limited ballot in person during early voting — but limited ballots are not available at Election Day polling places, so anyone in that situation who waits until November 3 could miss the chance.

The November 3 ballot includes the Laredo mayor's race, City Council seats in Districts 1, 2, 3 and 6, and Municipal Court Judge Place 1, along with county, state and federal contests. If no candidate in a race wins more than 50 percent, the top two advance to a December runoff.

What to watch next: the final early-voting total once polls close Friday, and then Election Day turnout on November 3, when polls are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
